dedupe_keys.name: battery archive shared repository of battery cell cycling and abuse test data from several institutions sandia national laboratories

description: Battery Archive is a repository for visualising, analysing and comparing battery test data from several institutions, supported by the US Department of Energy Office of Electricity Energy Storage Program through the Grid Energy Storage Department of Sandia National Laboratories. It holds two kinds of data, cycling data and disruptive (abuse) tests, with a description of each study. Users can query and filter cells by experimental conditions, display voltage curves and capacity fade, and apply performance and degradation models to the data. Coverage: laboratory tests of battery cells contributed by institutions; the list of studies was not read. Format and access: an interactive web interface; the complete CSV files for the cells in a study are sent on request by email; new data and software updates to the Battery Lifecycle Framework on which the site is built are published about every two months. Licence: not read. Caveats: data are cell-level lab results, not field data from grid storage; bulk access is by email, not by open download. Simulation uses: calibrating degradation and performance models of battery cells used in grid and distributed energy storage studies for capacity planning and resilience. Related records: the DOE Global Energy Storage Database (data-doe-global-energy-storage-database-sandia), also from Sandia, lists storage projects.
